cases.sentence: Но Иотам, самый ___ Еруббаала, спрятался и спасся.
cases.explain: «младший сын» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He went to his father’s house at Ophrah, and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal, being seventy persons, on one stone; but Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left, for he hid himself.

cases.sentence: Все жители Шехема и Бет-Милло собрались у ___ в Шехеме и провозгласили Авимелеха царем.
cases.explain: «священного дуба» — after the preposition «у», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: All the men of Shechem assembled themselves together with all the house of Millo, and went and made Abimelech king by the oak of the pillar that was in Shechem.

cases.sentence: Бог послал ___ между Авимелехом и жителями Шехема, и жители Шехема стали поступать с Авимелехом вероломно.
cases.explain: «злой дух» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,

cases.sentence: Жители Шехема, из вражды к нему, устраивали засады на ___, чтобы грабить каждого, проходящего мимо, и об этом было донесено Авимелеху.
cases.explain: «горных вершинах» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: The men of Shechem set an ambush for him on the tops of the mountains, and they robbed all who came along that way by them; and Abimelech was told about it.

cases.sentence: А Гаал, сын Эведа, вышел и стоял у входа в ___ как раз тогда, когда Авимелех и его воины выходили из засады.
cases.explain: «городские ворота» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city. Abimelech rose up, and the people who were with him, from the ambush.

cases.sentence: Многие пали ранеными у ___ в ворота.
cases.explain: «самого входа» — after the preposition «у», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many fell wounded, even to the entrance of the gate.

cases.sentence: Авимелех и отряды, которые были с ним, поспешили занять место у входа в ___, а два отряда ринулись на тех, кто был в поле, и стали убивать их.
cases.explain: «городские ворота» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Abimelech and the companies that were with him rushed forward and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city; and the two companies rushed on all who were in the field and struck them.

cases.sentence: Услышав об этом, все жители ___ вошли в убежище храма Эл-Берита .
cases.explain: «Шехемской башни» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: When all the men of the tower of Shechem heard of it, they entered into the stronghold of the house of Elberith.

cases.sentence: Но в городе была ___, и туда бежали все мужчины и женщины — все жители города.
cases.explain: «крепкая башня» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: But there was a strong tower within the city, and all the men and women of the city fled there, and shut themselves in, and went up to the roof of the tower.
